title: mkdir lacks post-create symlink/containment recheck; parent-symlink race creates dir outside root and reports success
notes: Imported by S-080 (D-015-04 amended) from the 2026-09-29 re-check: verdict fixed in db5b8c34 (shipped in v1.0.0-rc.10). Re-check evidence: dive/src-tauri/src/tools/mkdir.rs:57 calls verify_created_dir_inside_root after create_dir_all/create_dir. That function (mkdir.rs:74-85) runs reject_symlink_components, canonicalizes, and checks starts_with(root), returning PathDenied on failure. It mirrors write_file's verify_write_parent. db5b8c34 made the change and added the test mkdir.rs:117 mkdir_post_create_recheck_rejects_symlinked_parent. Guard resolved through its runner on 2026-09-29. Status stays fixed, not verified, until a live re-run on a rebuilt release records evidence. Guard repointed 2026-09-29 (Loop B review): the previous guard (mkdir_post_create_recheck_rejects_symlinked_parent) called the helper directly; the new test plants the symlink between resolve and create through the tool's run path and fails if the recheck call is removed (mutation-checked).
